name: gated-delivery
description: Issue-driven, test-first delivery flow with no client baked in. /spec turns a ticket into a signed-off spec with an ordered Rollout of independently safe PR slices; /slice implements each slice through executor batches with verification, structural and fresh-context correctness review at every merge boundary. Also ships /issue-writing, /story-drift, /repo-forensics, /senior-review-lens, /prose-writing, /prod-support, /deskcheck, /primer, /learn-flow and /audit-flow, the /gated-delivery:commit and /gated-delivery:commit-push-pr commands, and format, command-guard and verification hooks. Client specifics come from the client's CLAUDE.md.
